'''Rika Adachi''' (Japanese: '''足立梨花''' ''Adachi Rika'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Adachi was born on October 16, 1992, in {{wp|Nagasaki Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a {{wp|tarento}} and actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}}, voicing [[Merilyn|Merilyn Flame]] during [[M17|the seventeenth movie]]. Adachi then joined the {{pkmn|animated series}}, where she voiced several characters, such as [[Goh's Taillow]] from {{aniseries|JN}}.
